responsibility: This generator constructs GCC’s machine-mode universe and emits the enum and table data that describe mode classes, names, sizes, precisions, unit counts, wider-mode links, alignments, complex/vector relationships, real formats, and target-adjustable mode properties. It parses mode definition files, builds a typed graph of mode_data records across scalar, complex, vector, and fixed-point classes, applies target runtime adjustments, and can emit either the main insn-modes implementation, headers/inlines, or a reduced minimal mode table depending on command-line mode.
